title: How we handle your personal data.
intro: This notice explains what we collect through this site, why, and your rights under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019. Last updated: 24 November 2026.

controller.title: 1. Who is responsible
controller.body: The data controller is the Joyce Korir 2027 campaign. [[TO CONFIRM: campaign legal name, postal address, email and ODPC registration number]].

collect.title: 2. What we collect
collect.body: Only what you give us in a form: your name, phone number, county ward, and optionally your email, how you'd like to help, and any message. We do not collect your ID number, and we do not buy or receive voter lists.

why.title: 3. Why we collect it
why.body: To count pledges by ward, to organise volunteers, to reply to your message and — only if you tick the box — to send you campaign updates by SMS or WhatsApp. We use your details for no other purpose.

basis.title: 4. Our lawful basis
basis.body: Your consent (sections 30 and 32 of the Act). Because a pledge reveals a political choice, we treat it with the same care as sensitive personal data. You can withdraw consent at any time; withdrawing does not affect processing already done.

share.title: 5. Who we share it with
share.body: Nobody outside the campaign, except service providers who store or send messages for us under a written agreement. We never sell or rent your data. Some providers store data outside Kenya; where they do, we rely on safeguards under sections 48–50 of the Act. [[TO CONFIRM: final list of processors and their locations]].

keep.title: 6. How long we keep it
keep.body: Until 30 November 2027, after which we delete it, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. [[TO CONFIRM: retention period]].

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body: Under section 26 you may be informed how your data is used, access it, object to its processing, and ask us to correct or delete it. Contact us using the details below and we will respond within the time the law requires.

complain.title: 8. Complaints
complain.body: If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) at www.odpc.go.ke.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and tracking
cookies.body: This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. It remembers your lite-mode choice in your own browser only.

children.title: 10. Children
children.body: Our forms are for people aged 18 and over. Please do not submit a form if you are under 18.
